declarations: Proxies named: structure_shift and pivot_high for the resistance line; cmf for COM (not served, so no_data); elder_pattern and elder_5d for TIF; max(fib_swing_low, base_low_20d) for the support line.
System picked from each name's own picture, never the lane tag. Weekly-structure caution is a house rule (C21), not the author's. market_void null: my method has no market-wide condition.
ABSTAIN on ADP means no signal today, not a negative view. market_void null: my method has no market-wide condition.
